title: Normalize Draw Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize the draw plugin crate (draw/plugin/rs/**) to the repo-wide Wave-2 Consistency Contract: adopt PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/tree_item_with_action_draggable/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids) from semio_framework_plugin in place of local hand-rolled tree-item builders; adopt Terminology (app_labels! macro / LocaleLabels / resolve_labels / localized_label_map / AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder) in place of the hand-rolled DrawLabels struct + EN/DE consts + resolver + manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal; rename the app struct DrawApp -> DrawPlayApp (C1: PascalCase(app id "draw-play") + "App") with zero residue everywhere in the crate; fix region markers/order per C2/C3 (rename AppFactory -> Manifest, canonical Constants/Types/DocumentHelpers/Terminology/CommandLabels/Panels/Render/App/Manifest/Tests order); adopt Testkit (semio_framework_plugin::testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) in place of local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() test scaffolding. Mechanical pass only - do NOT touch the hand-rolled UtilityStateMachine region's internal logic (reserved for a separate Wave-3 FSM-consolidation agent); only reposition/leave it as a region, never edit its content.
summary:
Normalized draw/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Wave-2 Consistency Contract (mechanical pass only; the hand-rolled UtilityStateMachine region's internal logic was left byte-identical, reserved for the Wave-3 FSM-consolidation agent).

- PanelKit: deleted the crate-local hand-rolled tree-item builders and rebuilt build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree equivalents (render_layers_panel, render_catalogue_panel, layer_tree_item, boolean_child_item, tree_button) on top of semio_framework_plugin's tree_item/tree_item_with_action/tree_item_with_action_draggable/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids, keeping all per-app content logic (icons, drag-data shapes, nested boolean/group children, empty-state item).
- Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled DrawLabels struct + DRAW_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + draw_labels() resolver with an app_labels! DrawPlayLabels declaration + resolve_labels::<DrawPlayLabels>(); replaced the hand-rolled (id,en,de)->HashMap builders with localized_label_map calls (draw_action_labels/draw_utility_labels bodies unchanged, only the map-building mechanism changed); replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal in app_labels() with AppLabelsOverlay::with_framework_panel_tabs(...) + the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (.window_kind_label/.mode_label/.action_labels/.utility_labels), dropping the now-redundant panel_document/panel_catalogue/panel_inspection label fields (with_framework_panel_tabs produces byte-identical EN/DE values for the three standard framework panel tabs draw already used).
- C1 naming: renamed the app struct DrawApp -> DrawPlayApp (PascalCase("draw-play") + "App") everywhere in the crate (impl block, semio_plugin! apps list, all test helpers/signatures); grepped the whole draw/ directory (Rust, JSON manifest, JSON example) and confirmed zero residual "DrawApp" or "DrawLabels" identifiers.
- C2/C3 regions: renamed "//#region 🔖AppFactory" -> "//#region 🔖Manifest"; renamed "//#region 🔖DrawApp" -> "//#region 🔖DrawPlayApp"; reordered into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> DrawPlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests order (matching the already-migrated flow/sequence/protocol crates); the untouched UtilityStateMachine region now nests inside DocumentHelpers exactly where it previously sat, content byte-for-byte identical (diffed against the pre-edit snapshot to confirm); merged the former separate LayersPanel/CataloguePanel/InspectorPanel regions into one Panels region and the former Canvas region into Render, again matching the flow/sequence exemplar shape.
- C4 layout: confirmed single-app crate (one "impl DocumentApp for X"), left flat per the contract — no wrapping mod needed.
- Testkit: deleted the local meta()/new_app_with_registry() bodies' internals and re-based them on semio_framework_plugin::testkit (new_app() and new_app_with_registry() kept as thin local wrappers around testkit::new_app::<DrawPlayApp>()/testkit::new_app_with_registry::<DrawPlayApp>(create_draw_app), matching the sequence-plugin precedent); replaced every &meta() call site with &testkit::meta("local"); converted the one generic-shaped test (add_layer_undo_round_trip_through_wrapper) to call testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip with the app's own action/probe/expected-values as closure arguments. Draw had no MemoryBackbone::pair/convergence/idempotency test scaffolding to migrate (none existed).
- resource_kind: confirmed create_draw_app() already declares .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...}) correctly from a prior wave; no change needed.

Verified: brace/paren/bracket balance (487/487, 1894/1894, 240/240); every //#region has a matching same-named //#endregion (scripted pairing check, all OK); rustfmt --check parses the file successfully with only pre-existing style-diff noise (52 diff hunks vs 53 on the original snapshot — same baseline, confirms valid syntax, not a new regression); grepped for zero residual DrawApp/DrawLabels/ActionMeta/AppActionRegistry/fn meta(/UiTreeNode/UiTreeSectionNode; scripted cross-reference confirmed 1:1 parity between declared actions (.operation/.action_with(draw_internal_action/.view_action) and draw_action_labels entries, and between declared .utility(...) ids and draw_utility_labels entries; scripted cross-reference confirmed every DrawPlayLabels field is both declared and used (45/45) with no orphans; diffed the UtilityStateMachine region against the pre-edit snapshot and confirmed it is byte-for-byte identical; test count (21) and test function names identical before/after (only the deleted local meta() helper disappeared from the fn-name list, as intended).

Skipped: a full `cargo check -p draw-plugin` did not complete within the ~3-minute budget — the shared target dir has 100+ concurrent cargo processes from other sessions (confirmed via `ps aux`, e.g. concurrent checks for gis-plugin/vcs/flow-plugin/sequence-plugin/mathematical-plugin/process-plugin/layout-plugin all mid-flight), so the invocation sat blocked on the file lock with no output. Left it running in the background rather than blocking further; a full workspace check + test sweep is expected to run once at the end per the verification policy.

Nothing in this pass required expressing something the existing SDK primitives could not cleanly support — PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit primitives (tree_item family, PanelTreeBuilder, app_labels!/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt, AppLabelsOverlay::with_framework_panel_tabs, testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) all had exact-fit signatures for draw's usage with no gaps or workarounds needed.
